title: English in a Minute: Strike a Chord
source: VOA Learning English (미국 정부 제작물 - 퍼블릭 도메인). 원문: https://learningenglish.voanews.com/a/7974239.html

sentences.text: Welcome to English in a Minute.
When you strike a chord in music, you play several notes at the same time.
So are Anna and Andrew going to play music?
Her life really struck a chord with me.
But she was a pilot and you're afraid of flying.
Oh, now her flying career didn't strike a chord.
When something strikes a chord with you, it causes strong reaction, usually because you identify with it.
Striking a chord can also mean that you're reminded of something familiar.
